data.other_hard: at least a BSc; good academic standing; experimental doctoral (MD or PhD) or postdoc project in basic biomedical research; stay of up to 3 months; non-Europeans must carry out their project in Europe or use the grant to work in Europe
data.evidence_sentence: The travel grant programme is open to all Europeans and to non-Europeans working in Europe to go to institutes or courses worldwide.
data.notes: Listing is from a DAAD database page; the page text describes the Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds travel grants. Destinations are worldwide, so no single host country. Nationality set to ALL because the text covers Europeans and non-Europeans, with the location condition for non-Europeans placed in other_hard. Application is welcome at any time, submitted 6 weeks to 6 months before the planned departure. Target group also includes graduates who have applied for an experimental PhD project. The page gives no numeric GPA; 'good academic standing' is not a grade and was left out of min_gpa.
